original_ai_diagnosis.reasoning_summary: Observed symptom 'User plugged a laptop into wall jack Fa0/5 and the link light went amber. Host has no link or network connectivity.' correlates directly with configuration state in 'Switchport Security Err-Disabled Violation'. Evidence indicates fault at Layer 2.
recommended_fix_steps: SW1(config-if)# no switchport port-security mac-address sticky
original_ai_diagnosis.risk_assessment: Medium severity. Configuration modification should be verified against active routing tables.
original_ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Port security violation caused FastEthernet0/5 to enter 'err-disabled' state due to an unauthorized second MAC address.
original_ai_diagnosis.title: Switchport Security Err-Disabled Violation

human_correction.root_cause: Fix adjusted to prevent command side-effects or table locking.
human_correction.corrected_fix:
SW1(config)# interface FastEthernet0/5
SW1(config-if)# shutdown
SW1(config-if)# no switchport port-security mac-address sticky
SW1(config-if)# switchport port-security mac-address sticky
SW1(config-if)# no shutdown
SW1(config-if)# end
human_correction.reviewer_notes: Fix adjusted to prevent command side-effects or table locking.

lesson_learned: Fix adjusted to prevent command side-effects or table locking.

case_title: ACL Inverted Wildcard Mask Blocking Web Server

original_ai_diagnosis.reasoning_summary: Observed symptom 'Sales branch subnet (172.16.10.0/24) cannot reach internal Web Server (10.1.1.100:80). Traffic is blocked at border router R1.' correlates directly with configuration state in 'ACL Inverted Wildcard Mask Blocking Web Server'. Evidence indicates fault at Layer 4.
recommended_fix_steps: R1(config-ext-nacl)# 10 permit tcp 172.16.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.1.1.100 eq www
original_ai_diagnosis.risk_assessment: High severity. Configuration modification should be verified against active routing tables.
original_ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Inverted wildcard mask in ACL 101 line 10. Subnet mask 255.255.255.0 was used instead of wildcard mask 0.0.0.255.
original_ai_diagnosis.title: ACL Inverted Wildcard Mask Blocking Web Server

human_correction.root_cause: Fix adjusted to prevent command side-effects or taVerified that wildcard mask was corrected to 0.0.0.255 to allow internal Web Server traffic.ble locking.
human_correction.corrected_fix:
R1(config)# ip access-list extended 101
R1(config-ext-nacl)# no 10
R1(config-ext-nacl)# 10 permit tcp 172.16.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.1.1.100 eq www
R1(config-ext-nacl)# end
R1# write memory
human_correction.reviewer_notes: Fix adjusted to prevent command side-effects or taVerified that wildcard mask was corrected to 0.0.0.255 to allow internal Web Server traffic.ble locking.

lesson_learned: Fix adjusted to prevent command side-effects or taVerified that wildcard mask was corrected to 0.0.0.255 to allow internal Web Server traffic.ble locking.
